connector.name: Classquill MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for ClassQuill, a tutoring-business-management platform.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.classquill.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package equateit-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the equateitau account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EQUATEIT_API_KEY
env.description: Your ClassQuill API key (create one in the app under Settings -> Developers). Read-only for this server.
